name: mkt-app
description: Single-folder local run of the MKT CNBL/PNBL Approval app (backend + frontend).

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix mkt-backend && npm install --prefix mkt-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix mkt-backend" "npm run dev --prefix mkt-frontend"
